review_scope: Actual DOCX body text: every replaced and inserted paragraph, Figure 4 caption, reference 28, and consistency with local primary fulltexts and audited model/MD sources. This is scientific text review, not rendered page QA.

reviewed_section_functions.abstract_and_introduction: State the joint-output model finding and connect it to the paper validation sequence without claiming affinity prediction.
reviewed_section_functions.methods: Identify structures, held-out model, corrected CDR alignment, interface definition, consistent residue numbering, input-context removal, and independently repeated MD contact criteria.
reviewed_section_functions.background: Introduce MART-1/ELA and natural-parent versus affinity-matured receptor, then establish SPR and crystallographic evidence for the biological comparison.
reviewed_section_functions.complete_region_results: Show the two model readouts across full CDR loops and full pMHC interface before the local mechanism example.
reviewed_section_functions.Q72_Gly54_model_results: Use unchanged residue identities and TCR-context removal to tie sidechain concentration and backbone restriction to local environment.
reviewed_section_functions.inserted_mechanism: Use existing ITrace contact occupancy to support a local contact-network explanation, with published SPR/structure as separately sourced biological evidence.
reviewed_section_functions.discussion_and_conclusion: Explain the practical value of combining the two outputs at a concrete residue contact, without replacing measured affinity or total binding entropy.
